titulo: Shorts with a quality gate: hook, 9:16 cut and QA
lead: A short that loses its first three seconds doesn't get a second chance. MakeShorts puts two gates in the way: one on the script, which measures the hook before you record, and one on the video, which measures format, sound and frozen screen before you publish. In this lesson you fail and pass both, using dry-run files.
objetivo: write a hook that passes the script gate, and fail or approve a 9:16 video with the makeshorts QA.

aprende.t: The three layers of the hook: phrase, scene, and text on frame zero
The script gate: short hook, banned opening, keyword up front
The video gate: 1080×1920, 30 fps, h264/aac, −14 LUFS, no black screen
cardshorts: a narrated card short, five styles

hero_alt: A phone locked in vertical on a desk stand showing a blurred frame, next to a monitor with a timeline of short clips.

secoes.titulo: The two gates of a short

nos.detalhe: The phrase you say in the first ~2 s, the scene that appears on frame zero, and a very short text on screen. They fire together: someone scrolling with the sound off decides by what they see and read.
A Markdown file with the spoken script in the ### FALA section. Promo profile: 60 to 125 words.
Fails a hook longer than 9 words, a banned opening (olá, você sabia, neste vídeo…), and a keyword outside the first 15 words (≈ 5 s). Runs before you spend a render or an avatar.
Recording, local voice or avatar, real b-roll, vertical editing. In this course the video is a dry run made with ffmpeg.

Measures with ffmpeg: duration for the profile, 1080×1920, 30 fps, h264 and aac, loudness −14 ±1 LUFS, no black screen at the start, frozen stretches. Fails closed: if a measurement can't be made, it fails.

secoes.sub: Write all three before you record, and check that each one holds up on its own.

texto: What you say in the first two seconds. Get straight to it, with minimal context: no introduction.

exemplo.texto: "Your video dies in the first three seconds."

texto: What appears on frame zero. It has to stop the thumb of someone scrolling with the sound off: a contrast, a number, an object out of place.
A very short summary highlighted on screen. Someone who can't hear the phrase decides by it.
After the hook, contradict a common belief of the audience. That's what holds them until the proof. The full 7-step reel is in the social media course.

secoes.sub: Two scripts from the kit: one that passes and one that fails. The keyword is "gancho".

blocos.conteudo:
# Roteiro fraco
### FALA
Olá pessoal, hoje eu vou mostrar para vocês uma coisa muito interessante sobre como fazer vídeos curtos que prendem a atenção das pessoas. O gancho tem três camadas: a frase, a cena e o texto. Fica até o fim que no final eu conto o segredo.

K=~/projetos/formacao-cinema-ia-fabrica-v72/kit
cd ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-fabrica/a5; Q=makeshorts/.claude/skills/makeshorts/scripts
python3 $Q/qa_roteiro.py "$K/exemplos/a5-roteiros/bom.md" --keyword gancho > bom.txt; echo "bom: $?"
python3 $Q/qa_roteiro.py "$K/exemplos/a5-roteiros/fraco.md" --keyword gancho > fraco.txt; echo "fraco: $?"
grep -hE "❌|RESULTADO" bom.txt fraco.txt

abas.html:
bom: 0
fraco: 1
RESULTADO: APROVADO (falta: teste da lacuna, tese, fontes — revisão humana)
  ❌ gancho (palavras)        23 palavras: “Olá pessoal, hoje eu vou mostrar para vocês uma coisa muito interessante sobre c” (máx. 9)
  ❌ abertura proibida        começa com “ola”
  ❌ palavra-chave no início  “gancho” fora das primeiras 15 palavras (≈ 5 s)
RESULTADO: REPROVADO

The APROVADO on the script flags what the machine doesn't measure: whether the hook opens a gap, whether the thesis takes a side, whether the facts have sources. That part is up to you.

secoes.sub: The block clones makeshorts at a fixed commit, makes a 20 s dry-run video at 1080×1920 with normalized sound, and runs the QA on the promo profile.

blocos.rot: Terminal · QA of a dry-run short
blocos.conteudo:
E=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-fabrica/a5; rm -rf "$E"; mkdir -p "$E"; cd "$E"
git clone -q https://github.com/inematds/makeshorts.git && git -C makeshorts checkout -q 52eb799
Q=makeshorts/.claude/skills/makeshorts/scripts
ffmpeg -v error -f lavfi -i "testsrc2=s=1080x1920:r=30:d=20" -f lavfi -i "sine=f=220:d=20" \
  -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-2:LRA=7 -ar 48000 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -shortest ensaio-916.mp4
python3 $Q/qa_short.py ensaio-916.mp4 --profile divulgacao > qa.txt; echo "saída: $?"
grep -E "^(✅|⚠️|❌)|RESULTADO" qa.txt

blocos.rot: Terminal · the same QA on a 16:9 video
blocos.conteudo:
cd ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-fabrica/a5; Q=makeshorts/.claude/skills/makeshorts/scripts
ffmpeg -v error -y -f lavfi -i "testsrc2=s=1920x1080:r=30:d=20" -f lavfi -i "sine=f=220:d=20" \
  -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-2:LRA=7 -ar 48000 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -shortest ensaio-169.mp4
python3 $Q/qa_short.py ensaio-169.mp4 --profile divulgacao > qa169.txt; echo "saída: $?"
grep -E "^❌|RESULTADO" qa169.txt

abas.html:
saída: 0
✅ duração                  20.0s
✅ formato                  1080x1920
✅ fps                      30.00
✅ codec vídeo              h264
✅ codec áudio              aac
✅ loudness                 -13.9 LUFS
✅ sem tela preta inicial   imagem desde o frame 0
✅ frame 0 (informação)     0.063 de bordas
⚠️  trechos parados          1 acima de 4 s: 0.0–20.0s — justificar ou quebrar
⚠️  legendas                 não verificadas (passe --srt ou --words); reel sem legenda conferida não vai pro Nei
RESULTADO: APROVADO (falta a revisão humana: gancho, prova, pronúncia)

The numbers (−13.9 LUFS, 0.063 of edges) are from this machine, ffmpeg 6.1.1; on yours they may vary a little. What matters is the RESULTADO line. The captions warning refers to Nei's flow: in yours, pass --srt.

saída: 1
❌ formato                  1920x1080
RESULTADO: REPROVADO

Only the format failed: the rest of the video is the same. A horizontal video doesn't become a short by renaming the file.

secoes.sub: roteiro.yaml becomes a narrated 9:16 card short. MIT license. To render, it needs a local voice and image (inemavox and an image server with a GPU); here you only list the styles.

blocos.conteudo:
cd ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-fabrica/a5
git clone -q https://github.com/inematds/cardshorts.git && git -C cardshorts checkout -q d7f5c6d
cd cardshorts && python3 cardshorts.py estilos | grep -E "^[a-z]" 
grep -E "^(estilo|max_seg):" exemplos/versus/roteiro.yaml

abas.html:
celular    celular — interface de telefone: notificação, busca, fila e enquete SIM/NÃO
cracha     cracha — alvo, crachás carimbados e cédula; fundo grafite, acento vermelho
documento  documento — papel datilografado, formulário em branco, carimbos e certificado
extrato    extrato — nota fiscal / extrato bancário com borda picotada e carimbos
versus     versus — editorial preto e branco com vermelho; foto x foto, telas divididas, chamadas em Anton
estilo: versus
max_seg: 30          # a velocidade da fala é ajustada para caber (até 1,2x)

The max_seg is a ceiling: speech is sped up to 1.2× to fit and, if it still doesn't fit, the engine fails instead of cutting.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after you answer.

perguntas.p: qa_short.py approved the video. What did it NOT check?
opcoes: Whether the sound is at −14 LUFS.
Whether there is a black screen at the start.
perguntas.explica: The RESULTADO itself says it: human review of hook, proof and pronunciation is still missing. The mechanical part of the hook lives in qa_roteiro.py; the quality is up to you.

perguntas.p: Why does qa_roteiro.py run before recording?
opcoes: Because it needs the finished video to be able to measure.
Failing text is free; render and avatar are not.
Because makeshorts won't let you record without running it first.
Because it writes the short's script for you.
perguntas.explica: It's the same principle as the whole factory: check the cheap file before the expensive step.

perguntas.p: Your hook is "Olá, hoje vou mostrar três truques de edição" (Portuguese for "Hello, today I'll show you three editing tricks"). What does the gate say?
opcoes: Passes, because it has fewer than 9 words.
perguntas.explica: Starting with "hello" or "today I'm going to" is a banned opening in the contract: it spends the first seconds on an introduction.

perguntas.p: In a short, what decides whether someone stops scrolling when they have the sound off?
opcoes: The sentence spoken in the first second.
The scene and the text on frame zero.
The post description on the platform.
perguntas.explica: All three layers fire together, but with no sound only the scene and the text get through. That's why the sentence alone isn't enough.

itens.texto: sentence, scene, and text on frame zero, each one understandable on its own.
qa_roteiro before recording, qa_short before publishing.
the machine checks format and rules; gap, thesis, and source are up to you.
